newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Centamin in Egyptian gold venture.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Centamin in Egyptian gold venture.

text.p: Australian gold explorer Centamin NL said on Tuesday it had entered into a joint venture to develop Egyptian gold and base-metal project of Pharaoh Gold Mines NL.

Centamin said the project is estimated to contain more than 1.5 million ounces of gold. The assets of this joint venture will add to Centamin's Rosetta mineral sands project in Egypt and will focus Centamin's activities on the North Africa region.
Centamin's main emphasis will be to develop three old gold mines, and a tailings and dumps project in the eastern desert of Egypt, it said.
The three old mines - Abu Marawat, Berraminya, and Sukkari - have the potential to develop into large, low cost gold producers.
In addition, the company will explore a 5,000 sq km concession for gold and base metals, Centamin said.
At 1.10 p.m. (0310 GMT), Centamin shares were steady at four cents.
